description.value: WINGS Tap & Social is the downtown Vancouver location of the BC-based WINGS restaurant chain, a casual pub and dining spot renowned for its award-winning wings in 28 globally-inspired flavours. Described on its own website as 'food primary, all ages welcome,' it occupies a street-level space with both indoor and outdoor seating in the heart of downtown. A touring cyclist stopping here will find a full menu ranging from wings and burgers to salads and pastas, alongside a rotating tap selection.
